name: 16-layout mask, default recipe
hypothesis: Extends the four-layout design to 16 layouts: type-major and position-major indexing, each in (y,x) or (x,y) axis order, each under all 4 flip combinations. The mask goes in under all 16, and 16 per-type output maps are put back into those layouts and summed. If this world indexes actions position-major or with a 180° rotation, only this broader hedge can align the mask with the grid. Refuted if both seeds score 0 and late training success is 0.
